name: Lectern 04 · Post: new listings to the Discord channel, behind a switch

parameters.content:
## 04 · Post
Port of `build_messages()` in lectern/notify.py. Only companies still on the watch list, most-wanted first, nothing already posted, and a message with a path, an email address or a webhook URL is refused. **`send` is false by default**: the Discord node runs only when it is true, and it needs a Discord webhook credential (nothing secret is in this file). The message-building and refusal rules are tested; the Discord node itself is not exercised without a webhook.
